value_differences.gold_value: A model that misses the reliability downgrade has stopped too early. A model that rewrites preserved sibling branches without contrary evidence has over-revised.
value_differences.model_value: Under-revision failure: leaving state:primary as supported/medium after evidence:primary reliability dropped to low ignores the source-reliability-collapse signal; over-revision failure: propagating the impairment to state:secondary or any background branch that has independent high-reliability support would incorrectly widen the collapse beyond the revise_focus branch.
